**Install on a Mac:** download `Mnemo-{{version}}-arm64.dmg` below (Apple silicon), open it and drag Mnemo onto Applications. The app is signed ad hoc, not by an identified Apple developer: the first time, confirm in System Settings › Privacy & Security (« Open Anyway », « Ouvrir quand même » on a French macOS). On an Intel Mac, [build it from the source](https://github.com/GauthierCoste/mnemo/blob/main/docs/app/installation.md#build-the-app-from-the-sources).

**Install on Windows:** download `Mnemo-Setup-{{version}}-x64.exe` below and run it. The installer is not signed: if SmartScreen stops it, choose « More info › Run anyway » (« Informations complémentaires › Exécuter quand même »).

The app puts Mnemo in the menu bar (the notification area on Windows) and the interface in its own window, and carries its own Node.js and copy of Mnemo: you only need git and Claude Code. See [the app's documentation](https://github.com/GauthierCoste/mnemo/blob/main/docs/app/installation.md).
